svg.title: The machine for a?a?a?aaa reading aabaaa: after each byte, the states it could be in at once
svg.text: the machine, from the trace: splits (small, read nothing) and states that read one a

g.title: Before the first byte: from the start, every split is followed both ways, so the states that can read the first a are 1, 3, 5 and 6.
g.text: 4 live states, 4 summed so far (the trace's work); the machine has 10

g.title: "a" at 0: each live state that reads a steps on; that brings in 7, and the start, added again, keeps 1, 3, 5 and 6 live: 5 states.
g.text: 5 live states, 9 summed so far (the trace's work); the machine has 10

g.title: "a" at 1: each live state that reads a steps on; that brings in 8, and the start, added again, keeps 1, 3, 5 and 6 live: 6 states.
g.text: 6 live states, 15 summed so far (the trace's work); the machine has 10

g.title: "b" at 2: no live state reads it, so every partial match dies at once; the start is added again, and the live states are the first four again. Nothing is tried twice.
g.text: 4 live states, 19 summed so far (the trace's work); the machine has 10

g.title: "a" at 3: each live state that reads a steps on; that brings in 7, and the start, added again, keeps 1, 3, 5 and 6 live: 5 states.
g.text: 5 live states, 24 summed so far (the trace's work); the machine has 10

g.title: "a" at 4: each live state that reads a steps on; that brings in 8, and the start, added again, keeps 1, 3, 5 and 6 live: 6 states.
g.text: 6 live states, 30 summed so far (the trace's work); the machine has 10

g.title: "a" at 5: state 8 reads it and leads to 9, the match state. The line matches; grep prints it and stops reading.
g.text: 7 live states, 37 summed so far (the trace's work); the machine has 10
